name: TIERED SUFFICIENCY (v0.2) — the Bunkers Evidentiary Standard
model: A proposition does not earn a grade by accumulating points; it earns a grade by meeting a written standard of proof, the way a fact meets a burden in law, survives source criticism in historiography, or clears a confidence threshold in analytic tradecraft. The unit is the PROPOSITION, never the place: a site is a container of independently graded assertions, so "the hole is certain, the function is not" is the model's native sentence rather than an inexpressible edge case. Each band is a conjunction of checkable conditions, and the top two bands carry hard documentary or direct-observation requirements that no volume of circumstantial signal can substitute for — a hundred D0 observations satisfy zero D3 conditions, because conditions are typed, not summed. Evidence is signed and refutation is a band, not a flag: a proposition can be driven to R (REFUTED) by affirmative disconfirmation, and R is epistemically opposite to F (nothing resolves), not adjacent to it. Every observation is scored for its power to discriminate the claim from a MANDATORY named mundane alternative, so the signals shared by limestone mines, airports and sewer works contribute nothing by construction rather than by exception. Quality-of-record and probability-of-existence are separated by publishing the grade alongside an expected-record ceiling and a silence reading, so a fully operational facility under commercial cover reads "C, at the ceiling of what the open record can support for this class" and never "folklore." There are no weights, no continuous axes and no free parameters: every quantity is a deterministic receipt, a lookup into a versioned curated table, a count of rows, or a boolean condition with a written test — which is what makes it survivable when applied ten thousand times by LLM agents whose weights change under them.

# BUNKERS GRADING v0.2 — TIERED SUFFICIENCY
## A complete, self-contained specification

---

## PART 0 — WHAT CHANGED, IN ONE PARAGRAPH

v0.1 was a weighted sum over six 0–100 axes applied to a *place*. v0.2 has no weights, no axes, no composite, and no continuous scale. It grades *propositions* against *written sufficiency standards*. A proposition attains a band when a named conjunction of checkable conditions is satisfied; it fails to attain that band when any one condition fails, and the failed condition is published as the entry's `limiting_condition`. Disconfirmation is a band (R), not a flag. The mundane alternative is a mandatory field. Every quantity is a receipt, a table lookup, a row count, or a boolean.

---

## PART 1 — THE UNIT: PROPOSITIONS

### 1.1 A site is a container

A `site` record carries identity, geometry (subject to §9.4), and **nothing graded**. All grades live on `proposition` rows attached to the site. A site's page renders N badges, not one.

### 1.2 Closed proposition vocabulary

Only these classes exist. An agent may not invent a class. Each has its own dispositive-evidence definition (§4.4).

| Class | Form | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `EXIST` | A substantial artificial enclosed or subsurface structure exists at subject S | EXIST(greenbrier-wv-wing) |
| `HARDEN` | S is engineered to resist {blast, EMP/HEMP, CBR, forced entry, radiation} beyond ordinary construction for its class | HARDEN(33-thomas-st, blast+EMP) |
| `CONTROL` | S is/was owned, operated or occupied by named entity E, in period [t0,t1] | CONTROL(mount-pony, Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, 1969–1992) |
| `FUNCTION` | S served function F, in period [t0,t1] | FUNCTION(mega-cavern, civil-defense-fallout-shelter, 1962–1970s) |
| `STATUS` | As of date D, S's operational state is one of {active, standby, decommissioned, converted, sealed, demolished, never-built, unknown} | STATUS(cheyenne-mountain, standby) @2026 |
| `LOCATE` | S is located at coordinate C within radius R | LOCATE(pef-cartwheel, ±50 m) |
| `FEATURE` | S contains or exhibits specific feature X | FEATURE(mount-weather, internal transit system) |
| `PROGRAM` | Program P was {proposed, approved, funded, constructed, cancelled} with characteristics X. **Carries no physical claim.** | PROGRAM(DUCC, proposed-and-cancelled-1962-64) |
| `IDENTITY` | Named entity A is the same object as named entity B | IDENTITY(TITANPOINTE ≡ 33 Thomas Street) |
| `ORIGIN` | Claim K first appears in artifact Z at date D, and no earlier appearance exists in searched corpora | ORIGIN(dulce-base-claim, Bennewitz 1979–80) |
| `TYPOLOGY` | S is of type T, drawn from the typology vocabulary | TYPOLOGY(subtropolis, commercial-underground) |

**TYPOLOGY is a graded proposition, not a filter.** This is non-negotiable and closes the single cheapest gaming move in v0.1. Default typology for every new candidate is `unknown-anomaly`; it cannot change without a proposition that clears band C or better.

### 1.3 Mandatory fields on every proposition

```
proposition_id, site_id, class, subject, predicate_args, as_of_date,
null_hypothesis        -- REQUIRED, named, concrete. No proposition scores without one.
null_state             -- UNTESTED | SURVIVING | DOMINANT | INSUFFICIENT | EXCLUDED
typology_profile       -- selects the diagnosticity catalog (§3.3)
erp_profile_id         -- FK into the expected-record table (§5)
search_log_id          -- FK; must satisfy canonical coverage (§6) or grade is X
grade                  -- A|B|C|D|E|F|R|X
ceiling                -- highest band attainable given caps and ERP
at_ceiling             -- boolean
limiting_condition     -- the exact condition ID that blocked the next band up
silence_reading        -- INFORMATIVE | UNINFORMATIVE | UNSEARCHED | RECORD-DESTROYED
refutation_state       -- R0 | R1 | R2 | R3
scorer_model_id, rubric_version, tier_table_version,
diagnosticity_table_version, erp_table_version
transition_cause       -- on every version after the first (§10.2)
```

---

## PART 2 — THE EVIDENCE ROW

### 2.1 Nothing enters without a receipt

```
evidence_id, proposition_id,
receipt_state   -- VERIFIED | UNRESOLVED | DEAD | NEGATIVE
resolved_url, http_status, sha256_of_bytes, retrieved_at,
quoted_span, span_start_offset, span_end_offset, quote_check   -- deterministic, non-LLM
identifier, identifier_class, identifier_grammar_pass, issuer_metadata_match
origin_tier      -- T1..T5, FK into the single tier table (§2.3)
channel          -- ORIGIN | FAITHFUL-MIRROR | CURATED-ARCHIVE | AGGREGATOR | ADVERSARY-WRITABLE
causal_provenance -- UNSOLICITED | SOLICITED-3P | SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT | SELF-PUBLISHED | CROWD-EDITED
scope            -- INSTANCE | CLASS | ADJACENT
property_locus   -- CLAIM-PROPERTY | PLACE-PROPERTY
sign             -- SUPPORTS | UNDERCUTS | NEUTRAL
diagnosticity    -- D0..D4, FK into the catalog (§3.3)
lineage_id       -- assigned by LINEAGE (§4)
corpus_era       -- PRE-2022 | POST-2022-ATTRIBUTED | POST-2022-UNATTRIBUTED
first_observed_date, register_echo_quarantined (bool)
```

**RESOLVE-OR-DIE.** `receipt_state = VERIFIED` requires: identifier grammar passes; the identifier resolves at the *issuing authority* or a designated faithful mirror; HTTP 200; bytes hashed; and a verbatim span with character offsets that deterministic non-LLM code confirms present in those bytes. Anything else is `UNRESOLVED` and is **tier V0: arithmetically inert on every condition, but retained and displayed.** Format-valid-and-unresolvable is logged as fleet confabulation telemetry (§11.4).

**The tier of a document is the tier of its AUTHOR, not its HOST.** A public comment on regulations.gov is T4 hosted on a .gov domain. A DoD release on The Black Vault is T1 content acquired via a CURATED-ARCHIVE channel. Both facts are recorded.

**An interpretation inherits the tier of whoever asserted it.** A 1953 USGS quadrangle is T1. "This quad shows an adit at 38.744, −104.848" is an assertion; if a fleet agent made it, it is T5 and is a hypothesis, not evidence, until confirmed by (a) a second, different-model-family read, and (b) a citation to the era-correct USGS symbol standard for that sheet's imprint year.

### 2.2 The membership set V

For proposition P:

```
V(P) = { e : e.receipt_state = VERIFIED
             AND e.sign = SUPPORTS
             AND e.scope = INSTANCE
             AND e.causal_provenance IN {UNSOLICITED, SOLICITED-3P}
             AND e.corpus_era != POST-2022-UNATTRIBUTED
             AND e.channel != ADVERSARY-WRITABLE
             AND e.register_echo_quarantined = FALSE }

U(P) = same filters, but sign = UNDERCUTS
V[Dk+] = { e in V : e.diagnosticity >= Dk }
V[claim] = { e in V : e.property_locus = CLAIM-PROPERTY }
```

Six exclusions do enormous work and each is a one-line schema constraint:

- `scope = ADJACENT` excludes Project Gasbuggy from Dulce, and the FCC tower 3 km away from Site CARDINAL. **Proximity is not support.**
- `scope = CLASS` excludes the PEF program document from certifying any individual hilltop. Class-level evidence feeds `PROGRAM` and the ERP profile, never `EXIST` at an instance.
- `SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT` excludes the regulations.gov comment, the FOIA letter's restatement of the requester's own question, and any artifact whose existence was caused by the claim. **Evidence created after, and because of, a claim is not evidence for the claim.**
- `CROWD-EDITED` excludes OSM and Wikimapia entirely from evidence. They remain LEADS, displayed with changeset author and date.
- `SELF-PUBLISHED` maps Zenodo-class DOI deposits to T4 by construction: a resolving DOI is not an editorial assertion.
- `ADVERSARY-WRITABLE` excludes any host where an anonymous party can write the field being cited — Wikimapia descriptions, OSM changeset comments, Internet Archive item descriptions and user-uploaded PDFs, forum post bodies.

### 2.3 The single tier table

**One ladder, versioned, with per-source assignments for all 158 catalogued sources.** `origin_tier` is a foreign key into a curated table; an agent may PROPOSE a new source with a tier, but the assignment is a reviewed write. This ends the three-incompatible-ladders defect.

| Tier | Definition | Anchors |
|---|---|---|
| **T1** | The originating record office or its official machine interface; a record created by a party with direct authority or direct physical access, for its own purposes | CREST, DTIC, NARA Catalog, GovInfo, Federal Register, FRUS, GAO, agency FOIA rooms, FRPP, DoD BSR, MILCON J-books, USAspending/FPDS, county recorder/assessor, MSHA, USGS HTMC/3DEP/EarthExplorer, FCC ULS/ASR, FAA SUA, EPA NEPA repositories, AFHRA index, Chronicling America |
| **T2** | Faithful mirror of a T1 record, or professional curation over primary records that exposes its primaries | IA CREST/DTIC mirrors, National Security Archive EBBs, HathiTrust scans, AFU newsletter scans, corporate primary records (AT&T Long Lines route/plant literature), Ted Gup/WaPo 1992, Wayback CDX |
| **T3** | Independent rigorous secondary: FOIA-requester archives, peer-reviewed work, investigative journalism with named sourcing, disciplined enthusiast survey with cited sources | The Black Vault, governmentattic, Subterranea Britannica, Ed Thelen, Greg Bishop *Project Beta*, FAS Nuclear Information Project, Pollock/*The Progressive* 1976 |
| **T4** | Loose secondary: aggregator synthesis, enthusiast site without sourcing, unsourced press, wiki, self-published DOI deposit, crowd-map annotation, single-maintainer authority sites | GlobalSecurity, long-lines.net, Sauder's *conclusions*, missilebases.com, urbex sites, Wikimapia/OSM, Zenodo deposits |
| **T5** | Uncorroborated claim: forum post, video, anonymous testimony, oral rumour, machine-generated text, an LLM's own interpretation | AboveTopSecret, Godlike Productions, bibliotecapleyades, Coast to Coast archive, Grokipedia, uapedia.ai, AI listicle farms |

Two orthogonal dimensions ride alongside and are **never collapsed into the letter**:
- **Archive quality vs content quality.** A faithfully scanned T5 mimeographed newsletter in a T2 archive is a T5 document with high retrieval integrity. Record both. This is how the AFU collection becomes usable for `ORIGIN` grading.
- **Causal provenance** (§2.1), which is a third, independent question.

### 2.4 Corpus era and the synthetic-suspect rule

Every web source carries `first_observed_date` from independent archival snapshots (Wayback CDX), plus domain registration and pre-2022 capture history.

- **POST-2022-UNATTRIBUTED** = first observed after 2022-11-30, no named author, no byline history, no pre-2022 domain capture. Contributes **zero to every condition and counts as zero lineages**. Retained and displayed.
- A **versioned public blocklist** of known machine-generated corpora is maintained beside the aggregator reference set: Grokipedia, uapedia.ai, and the AI listicle farms as identified. Blocklisted hosts are T5 + POST-2022-UNATTRIBUTED by construction.
- **CAP-4, the pre-2022 evidentiary waterline:** any proposition whose entire supporting set postdates 2022-11-30 without a single verified pre-2022 document is capped at **D**, because the corpus can no longer distinguish independent witnesses from regeneration. This limitation is published on the methodology page.

---

## PART 3 — DIAGNOSTICITY

### 3.1 The rule

An observation contributes in proportion to its power to discriminate the proposition from the **named** mundane alternative. `null_hypothesis` is a required field. A proposition with `null_state = UNTESTED` cannot exceed band D.

### 3.2 The ordinal scale

Five levels, with likelihood-ratio glosses for intuition only — **agents assign by table lookup, never by estimating a ratio.**

| Level | LR gloss | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **D0** | ≈1 | The named null predicts this observation just as strongly. Contributes to no condition at any volume. |
| **D1** | ≈2–3 | Mildly favours the proposition. Satisfies band-D conditions only. |
| **D2** | ≈5–10 | Clearly favours. The null must strain to produce it. |
| **D3** | ≈20–50 | Strongly favours. Difficult to produce under the null; typically requires an institutional record. |
| **D4** | ≥100 | Near-dispositive on its own. |

### 3.3 The diagnosticity catalog — DEFAULT VALUES

Assignment is a **lookup into a versioned curated table**, not an agent judgement. New observation types are proposed by agents and adjudicated into the table by review. Below is the ratified default set.

**UNIVERSAL D0 — capped at D0 for every typology, permanently:**
adit or portal existence · spoil or muck pile · ventilation shaft · anomalous road grade into terrain · deep well · rail spur · fenced perimeter · large excavation volume · generator · fuel tank · guard shack · cameras · controlled access · "the locals say there's something under there" · a hill · a windowless wall · a basement.

*These are the signals shared by limestone mines, highway tunnels, sewer works, cold-storage caverns, data centres and large airports. Two hundred of them satisfy zero conditions above band D.*

**BURIED-RURAL / MOUNTAIN typology**

| D | Observation |
|---|---|
| D1 | Dedicated substation whose capacity exceeds visible built footprint by >3× · continuous thermal/lighting signature at an unoccupied-looking site · multiple redundant utility feeds · helipad with no medical or airfield justification |
| D2 | Restricted or prohibited airspace <3 NM radius, surface to <5000 ft AGL, **continuous** (not scheduled), with a **non-flying using agency** · HTMC editorial blanking (feature present on edition N, absent on N+1, with no demolition record) · heat-rejection capacity grossly disproportionate to occupancy · FRPP asset count materially below installation acreage (the withheld-asset gap, itself a citable absence) · MSHA controller identity = federal entity, records-storage or data-centre operator · fuel storage capacity far exceeding generator run-time norms for the building class · NTIA GMF federal frequency assignment at the coordinate |
| D3 | AT&T Long Lines hardened-site lineage in **corporate route/plant engineering records** · AFHRA unit history (IRIS number) describing the facility · earth-covered-magazine or command-post CATCODE in a real-property record for the parcel · NEPA document specifying blast doors, blast valves, shielding or CBR filtration · PSC C1xx architect-engineer design award for a hardened facility type at the coordinate with no subsequent public construction award · project unit cost >3× the UFC 3-701-01 pricing factor for its CATCODE · a **resolvable** named worker (independently locatable in a record predating the claim, created for an unrelated purpose: payroll, union roll, unit history, obituary, court filing, deed) describing the facility |
| D4 | MIL-STD-188-125-1/-2 (HEMP) cited in a design or procurement document **naming the site** · UFC 3-340-01/-02 blast design for the named project · DD Form 1391 for the named installation with hardening scope · a declassified record naming **facility + location + function** · an as-built or engineering drawing · a GSA disposal record describing a hardened special facility · a deed or court record reciting the structure · MILCON line item naming the facility |

**URBAN / IN-BUILDING typology** *(the axis-inapplicability defect dissolves: there are no axes, only a different catalog)*

| D | Observation |
|---|---|
| D0 | Windowless envelope · setback · bollards · rooftop generators |
| D1 | No leasable floor plate, no tenant directory, no retail frontage on a commercially zoned parcel · municipal benchmarking consumption above class norm |
| D2 | Structural floor loading >200 psf on multiple floors in building-department filings · roof vent-stack array disproportionate to stated occupancy · carrier-hotel meet-me room with emergency power disproportionate to tenants · benchmarking consumption ≫ class |
| D3 | The architect's own record describing a hardening programme · corporate engineering literature naming the building as hardened or survivable · dedicated-feeder utility interconnection agreement · unit cost ≫ class norm in permit valuations |
| D4 | Same D4 set as above (design-standard citations, agency documents, as-builts) |

**SILO / LAUNCH-FACILITY typology.** EXIST/CONTROL/LOCATE are near-trivially D4 (Air Force site lists, real property disposal records, recorded deeds). The interesting propositions are `STATUS` and current `CONTROL`; the catalog weights recent deed activity, county permit filings and dated direct observation.

**RELAY / COMMS, ARCHIVE-STORAGE, CIVIL-DEFENSE-SHELTER** typologies each carry their own catalog on the same pattern. Absent a catalog entry, an observation defaults to **D0** — the burden is on the evidence, not on the register.

### 3.4 The place/claim split — CAP-2

Every observation is `PLACE-PROPERTY` (true of the location regardless of the claim: terrain, geology, the mountain, the mine, the airport's size) or `CLAIM-PROPERTY` (a property of the asserted thing).

**CAP-2: a proposition supported by no CLAIM-PROPERTY item cannot exceed band D.** No combination of place-derived signals alone reaches "supported."

Entry pages render two separate bars: *how much of this grade is the mountain, and how much is the claim.*

---

## PART 4 — INDEPENDENCE AND CONTAMINATION

### 4.1 Lineages, not sources

A **lineage** is a set of evidence items causally descended from one origin. `L(Dk)` = the number of distinct lineages containing at least one item of `V[Dk+]`.

### 4.2 Collapse rules — enforced in the schema, not by agent judgement

1. Same author, same organisation, same publication → **one** lineage.
2. **All findings from agents sharing a base model → ONE lineage.** Same-family agent contribution to `L` is capped at 1 by construction. Agent independence is not source independence; N prompts over one set of weights is one witness speaking N times in different words.
3. **Transparent compiler pass-through.** A secondary source that exposes its primaries such that they can be independently pulled is a *conduit*, not a terminus: the primaries are the lineages, and the compiler is not counted or penalised. This is what stops a careful collation of forty Signal Agency documents from scoring as one rumour.
4. **Opaque compiler = terminus.** A secondary source whose primaries cannot be checked is one lineage and its floor.
5. **Replication is not independence.** Crowd-map geometry propagated into downstream renderers by database replication is one lineage regardless of renderer count.
6. **Semantic clustering, not string matching.** Lineage clustering operates on the *assertion*, not the wording, so paraphrase and machine regeneration collapse into the parent lineage. MinHash/shingle overlap is retained only as a fast pre-filter; it is not the test.
7. **The counterfactual test** (the one genuinely judgemental call in the model): *would this source have produced this claim if the prior source had never existed?* No → same lineage. Quorum-adjudicated by two agents of different model families, disagreement logged.
8. **Self-exclusion.** Any source whose first observation postdates the register's own publication of that candidate is quarantined — retained, displayed, contributing zero to L and zero to any condition — unless it is a VERIFIED T1/T2 document whose own creation date precedes the register's publication.

### 4.3 Contamination without a multiplier

There is no CONTAM score and no multiplier. Contamination is expressed structurally:

- **CAP-1 (single-lineage cap):** if `L(D2) ≤ 1`, the proposition is capped at **C** — unless band A is attained via a dispositive T1/T2 document (§4.4), which is an independent path and is *not* capped. One source is not corroboration at any volume; but one *sufficient document* is still sufficient.
- **CAP-3 (citogenesis cap):** if a T3+ publication rests on unattributable T5 testimony and is subsequently cited as though primary, `citogenesis = confirmed` and the laundered proposition is capped at **E**.
- **Total collapse to a fabricated origin** is not a cap at all — it is refutation R1 (§7).

### 4.4 Dispositive evidence, by proposition class

"D4" means different things for different classes. This table is the definition of A1.

| Class | A dispositive (D4) item is… |
|---|---|
| `EXIST` | A record produced by a party with direct physical access asserting the structure: as-built, engineering report, real-property record with RPUID, survey, recorded deed reciting the improvement, court record, or a dated interior photograph matched to an exterior control point |
| `HARDEN` | A design-standard citation (MIL-STD-188-125-x, UFC 3-340-0x, ICD 705 with blast/shielding scope, "HEMP", "shielded enclosure", "progressive collapse") in a document naming the site; or an engineering description of blast doors/valves/shock isolation from the designer or operator |
| `CONTROL` | FRPP RPUID, DoD Base Structure Report entry, recorded deed, GSA acquisition/disposal record, or a lease naming both entity and parcel |
| `FUNCTION` | A document from the operating agency stating the mission of the named facility: unit history, DD 1391 scope, EIS purpose-and-need, COOP/relocation designation, agency annual report |
| `STATUS` | A dated agency statement, a disposal record, or a dated direct observation |
| `LOCATE` | A surveyed coordinate in a T1 record, parcel geometry, or an independently reproducible georeference with published control points |
| `PROGRAM` | The decision record: FRUS/JCS/OSD memorandum, appropriations action, budget line, cancellation record |
| `IDENTITY` | A record from either party asserting the equivalence |
| `ORIGIN` | The dated earliest artifact itself, retrieved with a receipt, **plus a NEGATIVE RECEIPT** proving nothing earlier exists in the canonically searched corpora |
| `TYPOLOGY` | Any D4 satisfying the FUNCTION or CONTROL definition for that type |

---

## PART 5 — THE EXPECTED-RECORD PRIOR AND THE ARGUMENT FROM SILENCE

### 5.1 The rule

**Absence of a record is evidence only where the presence of that record would have been expected.** For a classified facility, absent records are the expected condition and carry near-zero negative information.

### 5.2 The ERP table — DEFAULT VALUES

Keyed on `(record_class × era × controlling_authority × classification_posture)`. Values: `EXPECTED`, `PARTIAL`, `NOT-EXPECTED`, `DESTROYED`.

| Record class | Condition | ERP |
|---|---|---|
| County deed / assessor parcel record | Any CONUS parcel, any era | **EXPECTED, always.** The universal floor — why CONTROL and EXIST are often gradeable when nothing else is |
| USGS HTMC quadrangle coverage | Any CONUS coordinate | **EXPECTED** (186,061 sheets, all downloadable) — so a temporal-stack absence *is* informative |
| MILCON appropriation / DD 1391 | Appropriated DoD, unclassified project | EXPECTED (but PARTIAL pre-1994 — GovInfo born-digital text starts ~103rd Congress; flag `ARCHIVE-GAP`) |
| MILCON line, "Classified Project"/"Classified Location" | Any era | EXPECTED for the *existence of a line*; **NOT-EXPECTED** for scope and location |
| CREST / agency declassification | CIA/NSA, <25 years old | **NOT-EXPECTED** (25-year rule) |
| Any documentary record | Active COG facility under commercial cover | **NOT-EXPECTED** |
| Appropriations, FPDS, FRPP, GSA disposal | **Non-appropriated / quasi-governmental entity** (Federal Reserve, USPS, TVA, FDIC, Farm Credit) | **NOT-EXPECTED — renormalised out.** Absence here is not a finding |
| Board annual reports, Board minutes, entity OIG, GAO audits of the entity, county deeds, state property records | Same entities | **EXPECTED** — these are the record classes that *do* exist and are enumerated in the registries |
| Individual military personnel records | US Army discharges 1912–1960; USAF 1947–1964 | **DESTROYED** (NPRC fire, 12 July 1973 — ~16–18M files, no duplicates, no index) |
| NEPA / EIS filing | Classified action | **NOT-EXPECTED** (classified annex or categorical exclusion) |
| FCC ASR registration | Covert emitter | **NOT-EXPECTED** — availability *anti-correlates* with the property being detected |
| MSHA record | Underground mine post-1970 | EXPECTED; pre-1970 **NOT-EXPECTED** |
| DTIC record | ADB-prefix accession | **KNOWN-TO-EXIST-NOT-RELEASED** — a distinct, positive state, not an absence |

### 5.3 The silence reading

Published on every proposition:

- **SILENCE-INFORMATIVE** — ERP = EXPECTED, the canonical search set was executed, negative receipts logged, nothing found. This is genuine negative evidence and feeds refutation R2/R3.
- **SILENCE-UNINFORMATIVE** — ERP = NOT-EXPECTED. *Rendered verbatim on the page:* "No public record of this class would be expected for a facility of this type in this period under this authority. The absence is not evidence against."
- **SILENCE-RECORD-DESTROYED** — ERP = DESTROYED, with the destroying event cited.
- **SILENCE-UNSEARCHED** — the canonical set is incomplete. Grade is forced to **X**.

### 5.4 The ceiling — how quality-of-record is separated from probability-of-existence

**The ERP does not cap the grade.** (A cap would create the bug where finding a document cannot help you.) It sets two published fields:

- `ceiling` = the highest band attainable *given the caps in force and the record classes that exist for this class of facility*. If ERP for all documentary classes is NOT-EXPECTED and no direct-observation path is available, `ceiling = C`.
- `at_ceiling` = grade equals ceiling.

**The register therefore publishes two things, never one number:** the evidentiary standard attained, and whether that standard is the epistemic limit of the open record for this class of object. An entry reading `EXIST: C — AT CEILING — silence uninformative` says something entirely different from `EXIST: C — ceiling A — blocked from B by: only one independent lineage`. The first is a statement about the world's opacity; the second is a statement about a weak claim. v0.1 printed the same number for both.

---

## PART 6 — CANONICAL SEARCH SETS (what "searched" means)

A proposition is **X (NOT ASSESSED)** until its canonical set has been executed and logged, each query with a **search receipt**: query string, corpus, corpus version/date, executed_at, result count, and NEGATIVE receipts for empty returns. *Absence is not citable without a receipt for the absence.*

| Class | Canonical corpora (all free, all machine-accessible) |
|---|---|
| `EXIST`, `LOCATE` | USGS HTMC temporal stack (point-in-polygon over `historicaltopo.csv`, 186,061 rows, `geom_wkt` in PostGIS) · 3DEP lidar where coverage exists (WESM footprints; SVF / SLRM / negative-openness visualisation) · EarthExplorer declassified imagery (Declass I/II/III via M2M) · county recorder + assessor · MSHA / USMIN / e-AMLIS / MRDS / state survey mine maps · FAA SUA · GNIS |
| `CONTROL` | FRPP · DoD Base Structure Report · GSA disposal + realestatesales.gov · USAspending/FPDS + SAM.gov · county deed chain · state business-entity registry · BLM MLRS/GLO |
| `HARDEN`, `FUNCTION` | CREST · DTIC (incl. ADB detection) · NTRL · NARA Catalog · GovInfo · Federal Register · FRUS · GAO + agency IG · agency FOIA reading rooms · MILCON J-books + DD 1391s · NEPA repositories (EPA EIS, service NEPA, DOE) · AFHRA index · ERDC/USACE publications · PSC/CATCODE/UFC string sweeps |
| `ORIGIN` | Wayback CDX (`collapse=digest`) · IA full-text `hits_inside` · AFU newsletter runs · UTZOO mirrors · Arctic Shift (Reddit) · ATS/GLP thread metadata · the mirrored aggregator corpus · Chronicling America + Open ONI state instances |
| `PROGRAM` | FRUS (git-clonable TEI) · GovInfo/Serial Set · Congress.gov · DoD Comptroller archives · NSArchive EBBs |

---

## PART 7 — REFUTATION

Refutation is checked **first** and **overrides all bands**.

| State | Condition | Test |
|---|---|---|
| **R3 — CONCLUSIVE** | A verified, instance-scope, unsolicited source from a party positioned to know **directly contradicts** the proposition | e.g. an appropriations record documenting non-funding; an agency statement that the facility does not exist at that location; a physical survey showing no structure |
| **R2 — NULL DOMINANT** | The named mundane alternative is (a) **affirmatively documented** by verified T1/T2 sources, (b) fully accounts for **every** offered observation, and (c) leaves **no D3+ residual** unexplained | SubTropolis, DIA, Louisville Mega Cavern's COG claim |
| **R1 — ORIGIN FABRICATED** | The claim's sole origin lineage is shown fabricated: an admission, a documented disinformation operation, a demonstrated forgery, a provably fictional source, or a **post-dating impossibility** (the claim's evidence postdates the claim's asserted date) | Dulce; Telos |
| **R0** | None of the above | |

Any R1–R3 → **grade R (REFUTED)**, refuting sources cited, entry retained.

**R is not F.** F means nothing resolves. R means something affirmatively resolves *against*. Collapsing them was v0.1's most consequential single error, and it is why a documented AFOSI disinformation operation could read as DOC credit.

**REFUTER's prior is typology-conditional, not blanket-refute:** default-refute for high-base-rate mundane categories (mines, quarries, water infrastructure, telecom huts, data centres); default-open for categories where the base rate of concealment is known to be high (COG, SIGINT, weapons storage). Blanket refute-by-default systematically erases the contemporary classified facilities the register exists to hold.

---

## PART 8 — THE BANDS

Checked **top-down**. The first band whose conditions are **all** satisfied wins. Then caps apply. Then `limiting_condition` records the first failed condition of the band immediately above the awarded grade.

### A — ESTABLISHED
> *"A dispositive record, independently resolvable, settles this proposition."*

- **A1** — At least one item in `V` at origin_tier T1 or T2, `property_locus = CLAIM-PROPERTY`, diagnosticity **D4**, meeting the class-specific dispositive definition (§4.4); **OR** two such items at **D3** in **two independent lineages**.
- **A1-alt (DIRECT OBSERVATION — `EXIST` and `LOCATE` only)** — Two or more independent verified direct observations by **resolvable named persons with lawful physical access**, each with georeferenced imagery matched to a public control point, **plus** a T1 record placing a structure on the parcel (deed, permit, or map).
- **A2** — Every identifier used to satisfy A1 passed grammar validation, resolved at the issuing authority, and **matched the issuer's own metadata** (title, date, issuing body) against what the agent claimed.
- **A3** — `null_state = EXCLUDED`.
- **A4** — No unrebutted verified `UNDERCUTS` item at D3+.
- **A5** — Every item satisfying A1 is `UNSOLICITED` or `SOLICITED-3P`.

*A single conclusive primary source reaches A. This is the documentary sufficiency principle and it is the whole point of the rebuild.*

### B — CORROBORATED
> *"Multiple independent lines converge; no single dispositive record."*

- **B1** — `L(D3) ≥ 2`; **OR** `L(D2) ≥ 3` with at least one lineage rooted at T1/T2.
- **B2** — `null_state ∈ {EXCLUDED, INSUFFICIENT}` — the null cannot account for at least one D3 observation.
- **B3** — No unrebutted verified `UNDERCUTS` at D3+.
- **B4** — `|V[claim]| ≥ 1`.

### C — SUPPORTED
> *"Positive evidence beyond what the mundane alternative predicts, but thin or single-threaded."*

- **C1** — At least one item in `V[claim]` at **D2+**; **OR** `L(D2) ≥ 2` from place-property items that the named null cannot jointly account for.
- **C2** — `null_state ≠ UNTESTED`.
- **C3** — No unrebutted verified `UNDERCUTS` at D3+.

### D — INDICATED
> *"Signals consistent with the proposition and equally consistent with the named alternative. This is where quarries live."*

- **D1** — At least one item in `V[D1+]`, or two or more D0 items forming a stated pattern.
- **D2cond** — `null_state ∈ {SURVIVING, DOMINANT, UNTESTED}`.

### E — ATTESTED ONLY
> *"The claim has an identified, dated origin and no independent verified support."*

- **E1** — `ORIGIN` for this claim is graded C or better (the origin is identified and dated).
- **E2** — `V[D2+] = ∅`.

### F — UNSUPPORTED
> *"Nothing resolves."*

The claim exists in the corpus and either no origin could be established, or no evidence survives receipt-checking. Retained with whatever origin work was done.

### R — REFUTED
Per Part 7. Overrides everything.

### X — NOT ASSESSED
Canonical search set incomplete (§6). **X is the correct default for every newly ingested candidate.** It is not a low grade; it is the absence of a grade, and it must be visually distinct from F.

### The caps

| Cap | Condition | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| **CAP-1** | `L(D2) ≤ 1` and band A not attained via A1/A1-alt | max **C** |
| **CAP-2** | `V[claim] = ∅` (place-derived only) | max **D** |
| **CAP-3** | `citogenesis = confirmed` | max **E** |
| **CAP-4** | All support postdates 2022-11-30 with no verified pre-2022 document | max **D** |
| **CAP-5** | `V = ∅` (nothing survives receipt-checking) | max **F** |

### The scoring algorithm — complete

```
GRADE(P):
  1. Evaluate R3, R2, R1 in order. If any holds -> return R.
  2. If search_log does not satisfy the canonical set for P.class -> return X.
  3. Build V, U; compute L(D2), L(D3), |V[claim]|, |V[Dk+]|.
  4. For band in [A, B, C, D, E, F]:
         if all conditions of band are satisfied: awarded = band; break
  5. grade = min(awarded, CAP-1..CAP-5)
  6. limiting_condition = first failed condition of the band above `grade`
  7. ceiling  = f(ERP, caps);  at_ceiling = (grade == ceiling)
  8. silence_reading = f(ERP, search_log completeness)
  9. Stamp scorer_model_id, rubric_version, all three table versions.
```

Every step is deterministic given the evidence table. The only judgement calls are (a) the lineage counterfactual (§4.2 rule 7) and (b) `null_state` disposition — both quorum-adjudicated across model families and logged.

---

## PART 9 — WHAT THE REGISTER PUBLISHES

### 9.1 The entry page
Leads with the **proposition table** — one row per proposition, each showing grade, ceiling, at-ceiling flag, limiting condition, silence reading, named null and its state. Then the alternative-hypothesis table. Then the lineage graph. Then the evidence rows with receipts, tiers, causal provenance and diagnosticity. The composite letter does not exist because there is no composite.

### 9.2 Two bars, always
**Place-derived** and **claim-derived** contributions rendered separately, so a reader sees at a glance how much of a grade is the mountain.

### 9.3 Publication gates
- Nothing below band **D** renders as a map pin. E, F and R entries live in the claims register with their origin work, which is the product.
- `LOCATE` below band C renders as a region polygon or county centroid with visible uncertainty, **never a point**. A precise pin manufactured from imprecise evidence is the register performing its own citogenesis at the interface layer.
- A provenance beacon is emitted on every entry and every API response, so downstream reuse is attributable and the register can measure its own footprint in the corpus.

### 9.4 New enum values (schema, before freeze)
`STATUS`: + `proposed`, `studied`, `cancelled`, `never-built`, `standby`.
`LOCATE precision`: + `non-located` (documented but coordinates genuinely unknown) — epistemically distinct from `claimed-only`.
`entity_level`: `program | site | structure`, with parent-child relations and an explicit **DISTINCT-FROM** relation seeded from the calibration set (Manzano Base ≠ KUMMSC).

---

## PART 10 — VERSIONING AND MOVEMENT

### 10.1 Non-pooling merges
Merges are **evidenced, reversible and non-pooling**. Every evidence row stays bound to the specific entity it names. A merge requires a named, verified, instance-level source asserting the identity (i.e. an `IDENTITY` proposition at band C or better). Coordinate proximity and name similarity are grounds to **FLAG**, never to merge. Merge and split rates are fleet telemetry.

### 10.2 Transition-cause vocabulary (mandatory on every re-grade)
`NEW-DISCLOSURE` · `NEW-SEARCH` · `NEW-VERIFICATION` · `RE-ANALYSIS` · `REFUTATION` · `STATUS-CHANGE` · `SCORER-CHANGE` · `TABLE-VERSION-CHANGE` · `RESCORE-NOISE` · `REGISTER-ECHO` · `MERGE` · `SPLIT`.

Disclosure-driven movement renders visually distinct from evidence-driven movement. `SCORER-CHANGE`, `TABLE-VERSION-CHANGE` and `RESCORE-NOISE` are **suppressed from the public confidence chart entirely** — the chart shows evidence events, not instrument drift.

### 10.3 The asymmetry
A grade may **rise** only on newly verified evidence whose own document date precedes the register's publication of the candidate. Downward movement carries no such restriction. The failure mode is inflation, so the ratchet is deliberately one-directional against it.

---

## PART 11 — RELIABILITY ENGINEERING

### 11.1 Why this model is measurable where v0.1 was not
Every quantity is exactly one of:
(a) a **receipt** produced by deterministic non-LLM code;
(b) a **lookup** into one of three versioned curated tables (tier, diagnosticity, ERP);
(c) a **count** of rows;
(d) a **boolean condition** with a written test;
(e) one of two adjudicated judgement calls (lineage counterfactual, null disposition).

There are **no continuous parameters and no weights**, so there is nothing to noise-tune. Inter-rater reliability is measured at the *condition* level — "did A2 pass?" is far more reproducible than "is DOC 78 or 84?" — and reported as per-condition agreement.

### 11.2 Blind double-scoring
A rolling **10%** sample is re-scored blind by a **different model family**. Per-condition agreement is published as standing methodology telemetry.

### 11.3 Pinning
Every grade row records the scoring model ID, the rubric version, and the tier/diagnosticity/ERP table versions. No grade is comparable across versions without re-scoring the baseline.

### 11.4 The canary programme
Rotating fabricated facility names with zero corpus presence are injected into the discovery queue every cycle. Any citation returned for a canary is a directly measured hallucination against known ground truth. Alongside it, the **format-valid-but-unresolvable rate** is logged per agent. Both are published on the methodology page: *a register that states its own measured fabrication rate is more credible than one that implies none.*

### 11.5 Regression suite in CI
The combined three-lens set — 15 + 17 + 11 entries — plus three pipeline tests that are not about facilities at all: the fabricated CREST identifier, the rotating canary, and the self-citation ratchet simulated against a staging corpus. Load-bearing pairs must reproduce exactly: Mega Cavern (shelter A / COG R), Kirtland (Manzano and KUMMSC never merged), Comet Ping Pong (R, for the stated reason), Fairview vs SubTropolis (HARDEN B vs HARDEN R), Greenbrier 1991 vs 1993.

### 11.6 Band-occupancy discipline
The ladder is deliberately calibrated so the **modal register entry is X or D**, not C. Most candidates are undifferentiated holes; a healthy register says so. If C-band occupancy exceeds ~15% of graded propositions, the diagnosticity catalog is leaking and is re-audited. This is the direct countermeasure to v0.1's compression of every real case into an undifferentiated C–E band.

---

## PART 12 — THE ANTI-GAMING LEDGER

| Attack | Cost to attacker | Blocking criterion |
|---|---|---|
| Emit a format-valid CREST/DTIC/GAO/ASR/PIID identifier | zero | **A2** (resolve + issuer metadata match) and **CAP-5** |
| File a regulations.gov comment naming the facility | zero, minutes | `SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT` → excluded from V; author-tier T4 not host-tier T1 |
| FOIA a no-records letter restating your own facility name | zero, weeks | The requester's question is `SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT`; the agency's answer is a NEGATIVE receipt usable only where ERP = EXPECTED |
| Mint a Zenodo DOI for a "technical assessment" | zero | `SELF-PUBLISHED` → T4; A1 requires T1/T2 |
| Tag `military=bunker` in OSM/Wikimapia | free account | `CROWD-EDITED` → lead, never evidence; replication is one lineage |
| Pick a real place with portals, substation and title chain | zero | **CAP-2** — place-property alone caps at D; FUNCTION requires an instance-level function-naming D3+ |
| Relabel typology COG/COOP for free | zero | TYPOLOGY is a graded proposition; the relabel instantiates FUNCTION(COG), which is immediately R or E |
| Let AI content farms regenerate the claim | zero | `POST-2022-UNATTRIBUTED` → zero; semantic clustering collapses paraphrase; **CAP-4** waterline |
| Prompt-inject identifiers into a Wikimapia description | one HTTP POST | Fetched text enters as DATA; identifiers from untrusted text are LEADS requiring independent resolution; `ADVERSARY-WRITABLE` channel excluded; cache-and-revalidate with drift alerts |
| Name the invention to collide with a real site so RESOLVER merges it | zero | Merges require an `IDENTITY` proposition at C+; evidence never pools; DISTINCT-FROM relation |
| Wait for the register to cite its own echo | zero, months | Self-exclusion quarantine; upward movement requires pre-existing document dates |

Producing an A-band fraudulently requires forging a record **inside a federal repository** with matching issuer metadata — not writing a comment, minting a DOI, or editing a map. That asymmetry is the design.

**The rubric is published with the explicit warning that it is a public optimisation target**, and a red-team calibration set of deliberately constructed adversarial candidates runs in CI beside the true-positive set.

Disconfirmation has three separate hooks: (a) an unrebutted verified UNDERCUTS item at D3+ fails conditions A4/B3/C3 and blocks the top three bands; (b) the refutation ladder R1/R2/R3 is checked FIRST and overrides every band; (c) band R exists and is epistemically opposite to F. Dulce's AFOSI documentation is no longer DOC credit — it is R1, and it drives EXIST to R. SubTropolis's refutation is no longer a flag next to C — it IS the grade.

**2. UNIT ERROR (place vs proposition).** RESOLVED. Grading attaches only to `proposition` rows from a closed eleven-class vocabulary. A site carries identity and geometry and NOTHING graded. Camp Hero publishes EXIST A alongside 'Montauk Project' R at the same coordinates. Mount Weather publishes site A alongside FEATURE(underground city) E with the citogenesis flag attached to the proposition. Cheyenne Mountain publishes EXIST A alongside STATUS(current NORAD HQ) R. No proposition can inherit another's evidence because evidence rows are keyed to `proposition_id`, and `scope = ADJACENT` plus `scope = CLASS` block the two remaining laundering routes.

**3. NO DIAGNOSTICITY.** RESOLVED. Diagnosticity D0–D4 is a required per-observation field assigned by lookup into a versioned catalog, against a MANDATORY named null (`null_hypothesis` is not nullable; `null_state = UNTESTED` caps at D). The universal-D0 list is explicit and permanent: adits, spoil, ventilation, road grade, deep wells, rail spurs, substations, fenced perimeters, large excavations. Band conditions are TYPED — B1 requires L(D3) ≥ 2, and no quantity of D0 observations produces a single D3 lineage. There is no summation, so 200 non-diagnostic observations cannot accumulate into anything. The 54%-of-weight-on-the-least-diagnostic-axes problem is dissolved rather than reweighted, because there are no axes and no weights.

**4. ARITHMETIC CONTRADICTION (conclusive primary source → grade E).** RESOLVED. Band A is attained by A1: ONE verified T1/T2 D4 item meeting the class-specific dispositive definition. A single declassified record naming facility, location and function is band A on its own. The band LABELS and the band CONDITIONS are now literally the same text — 'ESTABLISHED' is defined as 'A1–A5 satisfied', not as a number range — so the two-instruments-bolted-together problem cannot recur. A1-alt adds a second sufficient path (direct observation) so that a facility you can stand in also reaches A.

**5. CONFIDENCE-IN-EVIDENCE PUBLISHED AS EXISTENCE / NO EXPECTED-RECORD PRIOR.** RESOLVED. Three separate published fields: `grade` (the evidentiary standard attained — quality of record), `ceiling` + `at_ceiling` (whether that standard is the epistemic limit for this class of object), and `silence_reading` ∈ {INFORMATIVE, UNINFORMATIVE, RECORD-DESTROYED, UNSEARCHED}. The ERP table (Part 5.2) is a versioned lookup keyed on record class × era × controlling authority × classification posture. Greenbrier-1991 publishes 'EXIST B — AT CEILING — silence uninformative: no public record of this class would be expected for a facility under commercial cover; the absence is not evidence against.' DUCC publishes silence INFORMATIVE, because for an appropriated construction programme of that scale the records WOULD be expected — the same table that forbids the inference in one case licenses it in the other. Band prose describes evidence states only; no band asserts existence.

**6. CONTAM FLOORS AT ×0.5, F UNREACHABLE.** RESOLVED. There is no multiplier and no CONTAM score. Total lineage collapse to a fabricated origin is R1 → grade R, which is below F. Total collapse to a single origin is CAP-1 → max C. Citogenesis is CAP-3 → max E. Nothing survives receipt-checking is CAP-5 → max F. Every floor is gone.

**7. COR COUNTS SOURCES; AGENT ARCHITECTURE MANUFACTURES FALSE CORROBORATION.** RESOLVED. There is no COR axis. `L(Dk)` counts LINEAGES containing at least one verified, instance-scope, D-k-or-better item, under eight collapse rules enforced in the schema. Rule 2 is the decisive one: **all findings from agents sharing a base model constitute ONE lineage, capped at 1 by construction.** Rule 3 (transparent-compiler pass-through) fixes the inverse error, so a careful collation of forty Signal Agency documents is forty lineages and the compiler is not penalised — which is what drags Cartwheel out of D. Rule 6 replaces textual-overlap detection with claim-level semantic clustering, so machine-regenerated paraphrase collapses into its parent. Rule 8 quarantines the register's own echo. The v0.1 sentence claiming agent blindness produces source independence is deleted; blind fan-out is retained for RECALL only, which is its actual justification.

**8. GEO'S BURIED-RURAL PRIOR.** RESOLVED. There is no GEO axis to be inapplicable. `typology_profile` selects a diagnosticity catalog; urban/in-building has its own D1–D4 anchors (floor loading in building-department filings, vent-stack morphology, benchmarking consumption, dedicated-feeder interconnection agreements, the architect's own record). 33 Thomas Street reaches HARDEN A on documentation alone. Nothing is 'renormalised out', because nothing was ever weighted in.

=== THE ADVERSARIAL SKEPTIC'S FATALS ===

**S1. NO VERIFICATION TIER.** RESOLVED — and this is the load-bearing addition. Resolve-or-die is a SCHEMA CONSTRAINT, not an agent's diligence: `receipt_state = VERIFIED` requires resolved URL, HTTP status, SHA-256 of retrieved bytes, retrieval timestamp, and a verbatim span with character offsets confirmed present in those bytes by deterministic non-LLM code. Grammar validators plus resolution plus **issuer metadata match** (A2) — the third check catches a real document misattributed to the wrong facility, which no existence check detects. Tier **V0-UNRESOLVED** contributes zero to every condition while remaining visible. CAP-5 caps a receipt-less candidate at F. Format-valid-but-unresolvable is logged as fleet telemetry. Identifier grammars covered: CREST CIA-RDP, DTIC AD, NARA NAID, GAO report numbers, Federal Register cites, FCC ASR, FPDS PIID, FRUS volume/document, GovInfo package ID, USGS quad name+year, county parcel ID, MSHA MINE_ID, AFHRA IRIS, DOI, IA identifier. The Sauder-as-bibliography move survives and is CORRECTLY handled: identifiers regexed out of a fringe book are LEADS, and only become citations after independent resolution at DTIC/NTRL/Federal Register — his documents get promoted, his conclusions stay T4. The verifier is deterministic code or a different model family; an LLM never verifies its own family's output.

**S2. TYPOLOGY EXCLUDED FROM SCORING.** RESOLVED. TYPOLOGY is a graded proposition class. Default is `unknown-anomaly` and it cannot move without a proposition clearing band C. Changing the label to COG/COOP does not silently rewrite a filter — it instantiates FUNCTION(COG/COOP), which is scored, and for Mega Cavern is immediately R. There is no composite to leave unmoved.

**S3. CHEAPEST PATH TO B COSTS ZERO AND FABRICATES NOTHING.** RESOLVED by CAP-2: a proposition with no CLAIM-PROPERTY item cannot exceed D. Place-derived and claim-derived contributions render as two separate bars on every entry page. The v0.1 firewall ceiling of 83.20 has no analogue: there is no accumulation path at all. The rubric is published with an explicit warning that it is a public optimisation target, and a red-team adversarial calibration set runs in CI alongside the true-positive set.

**S4. SHARED MODEL PRIORS INVERT CONTAM AND INFLATE COR SIMULTANEOUSLY.** RESOLVED by lineage collapse rule 2 (schema-enforced same-family cap at 1) plus rule 6 (semantic clustering, so divergent surface text does not create divergent lineages) plus the resolve-or-die requirement (an unverified agent assertion is not a lineage at all — it is a hypothesis awaiting retrieval). Fleet independence is MEASURED, not asserted: a rolling sample runs through different model families and inter-family agreement is published. High agreement on VERIFIED sources is corroboration; high agreement on UNVERIFIED assertions is a shared-prior signature and is treated as such.

**S5. CONTAM DETECTS COPYING; LLM CONTAMINATION IS REGENERATION.** RESOLVED. Corpus-era tagging is a required field. POST-2022-UNATTRIBUTED (no named author, no byline history, no pre-2022 domain capture) contributes zero and counts as zero lineages, retained and displayed. A versioned public blocklist of machine-generated corpora sits beside the aggregator reference set — Grokipedia, uapedia.ai, the listicle farms — and blocklisted hosts are T5 by construction, which also closes the 'Grokipedia is a wiki so it's P4 and P4 is only gated on DOC' hole, since there is no per-axis gating to route around. Lineage clustering is semantic, not textual. CAP-4 establishes the pre-2022 evidentiary waterline: entire-support-postdates-Nov-2022 without a verified pre-2022 document caps at D, stated publicly on the methodology page.

**S6. THE DOC FIREWALL IS BREACHED FOR FREE THROUGH LEGITIMATE .GOV CHANNELS.** RESOLVED by `causal_provenance` as a dimension orthogonal to institutional tier, plus the rule that **the tier of a document is the tier of its author, not its host.** SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT contributes zero everywhere: regulations.gov comments, and the requester's half of a FOIA letter. The agency's half of that same PDF is a NEGATIVE receipt, usable only where ERP = EXPECTED — the schema distinguishes the two halves of one document. SELF-PUBLISHED maps Zenodo-class deposits to T4 (a resolving DOI is not an editorial assertion; A1 requires T1/T2). CROWD-EDITED makes OSM and Wikimapia leads-only, and database replication into downstream renderers is one lineage. General rule stated: evidence created after, and because of, a claim is not evidence for the claim.

=== THE SKEPTIC'S MAJORS ===

**S7. PROMPT INJECTION + CACHE-ONCE.** ADDRESSED. Fetched text enters as DATA behind a hard structural boundary, never as free prose in a scoring context. Identifiers extracted from untrusted text are LEADS requiring independent resolution at the issuing authority — S1's verification tier already provides the mechanism, and the `ADVERSARY-WRITABLE` channel flag excludes such hosts from V outright. Cache-once is replaced with cache-and-revalidate: content hashes stored, scheduled re-fetch, drift alerts. A source that changes after being cited is a signal. Adversary-writability is recorded per source and surfaced on the entry page. Injection red-team suite in CI against the live ingestion path.

**S8. SCORER NOISE EXCEEDS BAND WIDTH.** ADDRESSED STRUCTURALLY. There are no continuous scales and no weights, therefore no composite σ to compute — the σ=6.6-to-11 calculation has no analogue because every quantity is a receipt, a table lookup, a row count, or a boolean. Reliability is measured at the CONDITION level ('did A2 pass?') and published as per-condition agreement. Rolling 10% blind double-scoring by a different model family. Scorer model ID, rubric version and all three table versions stamped on every grade row. SCORER-CHANGE, TABLE-VERSION-CHANGE and RESCORE-NOISE are in the transition-cause vocabulary and are SUPPRESSED ENTIRELY from the public confidence chart. Band-occupancy discipline (§11.6) targets X and D as the modal bands and triggers a catalog audit if C exceeds ~15%.

**S9. THREE INCOMPATIBLE P-TIER LADDERS ALREADY IN W0 OUTPUT.** RESOLVED. One versioned tier table with per-source assignments for all 158 catalogued sources; `origin_tier` is a foreign key and assignment is a reviewed write, not an inline judgement. Archive quality and content quality are carried as separate dimensions (a faithfully scanned T5 newsletter in a T2 archive is a T5 document with high retrieval integrity — which is exactly what makes the AFU collection usable for ORIGIN grading). Causal provenance is the third orthogonal dimension. The specific collisions are adjudicated in the ratified table: Black Vault and governmentattic are **T3 hosts delivering T1 content** (record both); GlobalSecurity is **T4**, explicitly registered as a tier trap and a hop rather than a terminus; Internet Archive is a **channel**, not a tier — an IA-mirrored CREST document is T1 content via FAITHFUL-MIRROR, while a user-uploaded PDF is T5 via ADVERSARY-WRITABLE.

**S10. RESOLVER IS A SCORE-LAUNDERING PRIMITIVE.** RESOLVED. Merges are evidenced (require an IDENTITY proposition at band C+ backed by a named verified instance-level source), reversible (both constituents retained, split operation provided), and NON-POOLING (every evidence row stays bound to the entity it names; if merging raises a grade, the merge is doing unjustified evidentiary work). Coordinate proximity and name similarity FLAG, never merge. `entity_level ∈ {program, site, structure}` plus an explicit DISTINCT-FROM relation seeded from the calibration set, so Manzano Base and KUMMSC are asserted apart in the schema and can never silently re-merge — while KUMMSC/KUMSC merges correctly on a name-variant IDENTITY proposition. Merge and split rates tracked as telemetry.

**S11. THE REGISTER BECOMES ITS OWN SOURCE (W4 ratchet).** RESOLVED. The register keeps a complete timestamped record of everything it has published. Any source whose first observation postdates the register's publication of that candidate is quarantined — retained, displayed, zero contribution to L and zero to any condition — unless it is a verified T1/T2 document whose own creation date precedes publication. A machine-readable provenance beacon is emitted on every entry and API response. The asymmetry is explicit: a grade may RISE only on newly verified evidence with a pre-existing document date; downward movement carries no restriction, because the failure mode is inflation. REGISTER-ECHO is in the transition-cause vocabulary. The loop is published on the methodology page.

**S12. NON-APPROPRIATED / QUASI-GOVERNMENTAL BLIND SPOT.** RESOLVED. The ERP table is keyed on controlling authority. For the Federal Reserve, USPS, TVA, FDIC and the Farm Credit System, appropriations/FPDS/FRPP/GSA-disposal are NOT-EXPECTED and renormalise out — the searches still run, and their negative receipts are annotated 'record class does not exist for this controlling authority' without touching the grade. The record classes that DO exist are enumerated and added to the registries: Board annual reports and minutes, FRB district publications, entity OIG, GAO audits of the entity, county deeds and assessor records, and in Mount Pony's case the Library of Congress acquisition record and the Packard Foundation grant. The coverage map is published: a documented blind spot is a caveat; a silent one is a false negative and a safe harbour a fabricator will find.

=== THE HISTORIAN'S REMAINING FATALS AND MAJORS ===

**H7 (COR and CONTAM are one variable measured twice, swinging ~40 points).** One independence term, `L(Dk)`, applied once, with no multiplier. Causal independence is the test, not distinct personhood: Bennewitz, LeVesque, 'Castello' and Schneider are four names inside one subculture that read each other — one lineage.
**H8 (CONTAM cannot distinguish rumour from scholarship).** Collapse rule 3, transparent-compiler pass-through, with an explicit test: does the secondary expose its primaries such that they can be independently pulled?
**H9 (firewall covers DOC only; TEST accepts any 'named' account).** There are no axes to gate separately; every condition runs off the same tier-and-diagnosticity-typed V set. Testimony scores RESOLVABILITY, not form: full D3 credit only where the individual is independently locatable in a record that PREDATES the claim and was created for an unrelated purpose. 'Thomas Castello' → D0. A Greenbrier construction worker in a union roll and an obituary → D3.
**H10 (program evidence credited at full strength to every instance).** `scope ∈ {INSTANCE, CLASS, ADJACENT}`; CLASS-scope evidence feeds the PROGRAM proposition and the ERP profile and is excluded from V for instance propositions. Enforced at write time: a source cited by more than one candidate must be CLASS-scope or the entity resolution is wrong.
**H11 (no status band for proposed/cancelled/never-built).** Added to the STATUS enum; DUCC returns PROGRAM A / EXIST R / STATUS never-built.
**H12 (location precision is a filter, not a graded proposition).** LOCATE is a proposition class; §9.3 gates RENDERING on it — below band C renders as a region polygon or county centroid with visible uncertainty, never a point. NON-LOCATED added, distinct from claimed-only.
**H13 (differential survival of records).** ERP values EXPECTED/PARTIAL/NOT-EXPECTED/DESTROYED, with the NPRC fire of 12 July 1973 as a named DESTROYED entry covering Army discharges 1912–1960 and USAF 1947–1964, and with NEPA-for-classified-actions and FCC-ASR-for-covert-emitters marked NOT-EXPECTED on the explicit ground that their availability ANTI-correlates with the property being detected. Published sampling-bias statement.
**H14 (disclosure history rendered as evidence history; refute-by-default).** Mandatory transition_cause with NEW-DISCLOSURE rendered visually distinct. REFUTER's blanket refute-by-default is replaced with a typology-conditional prior: default-refute for high-base-rate mundane categories, default-open where the base rate of concealment is known to be high.

=== THE IC ANALYST'S REMAINING FATALS AND MAJORS ===

**I6 (REFUTER has no arithmetic power; multi-vote at the wrong threshold).** REFUTER owns null_hypothesis, null_state and the refutation ladder — two of five band conditions plus an override. Multi-vote is mandatory across the C–E band where mundane explanations live, plus band A. The alternative-hypothesis table is published on every entry page.
**I7 (weights asserted; axes not independent; one fact enters four axes).** No weights exist to assert. Each underlying fact produces ONE evidence row against ONE proposition, so the Fairview 'it was a Long Lines station' fact cannot enter four times across 82% of the weight.
**I8 (no base rate, no prior, no confirmation-bias control).** The prior lives in two places: the universal-D0 list (which encodes that anomalous underground signature is overwhelmingly mundane) and the typology-conditional REFUTER prior. Null returns are required from every Tier 1 agent and are the base-rate denominator. Per-agent grade distributions are published as bias telemetry alongside per-agent confabulation rates.
**I9 (compressed dynamic range; everything lands in C–E).** The bands are sufficiency conditions, not thresholds, so there is no window to compress into. §11.6 sets X and D as the target modal bands and audits the catalog if C exceeds ~15%. The twelve worked examples span A, B, C, D, E, F, R and X, and the middle-band cases carry `at_ceiling` and `limiting_condition`, which distinguish 'C because the record is closed' from 'C because the claim is weak' — a distinction v0.1 could not make and which is the actual product.
**I10 (taxonomy and bookkeeping gaps).** All added before schema freeze: STATUS gains proposed/studied/cancelled/never-built/standby; LOCATE gains non-located; entity_level {program, site, structure} with parent-child relations and DISTINCT-FROM. The 'is one source CONTAM 100 or undefined' problem vanishes — there is no CONTAM; one lineage is CAP-1 → max C, and a newly discovered single-document candidate is not born maximally contaminated, it is born at C or, if the document is dispositive, at A.

=== ONE OPEN DISAGREEMENT, STATED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED ===

Denver International Airport: the IC lens expected E; v0.2 returns R, because R2 requires the null to be affirmatively DOCUMENTED rather than merely available, and for DIA it is (GAO audits, the 2005 baggage-system deactivation, the fuel farm permits). Both answers sit at the bottom and both satisfy the lens's operative requirement that it must not reach D or C, and the lens's underlying concern is met by EXIST(large underground works) = A published alongside. This is logged as a calibration-set adjudication item, not resolved by fiat.
